summary.oneLiner: An industrial digital automation solutions provider designing, assembling and commissioning automated assembly lines, material handling systems and special purpose machinery primarily for the automotive sector.
summary.business: Adisoft designs, develops, procures, assembles, tests, installs and commissions automated assembly lines, material handling machines, robotic work cells and special purpose machinery, integrating shop-floor equipment with the IT layer (PLC/SCADA/GOT/IoT/MES) to automate industrial processes. It serves automobile manufacturers, automotive OEMs and component/sub-component makers, with a smaller share from non-automotive sectors, and also provides AMC, retrofitting, installation and lifecycle support services. Systems are assembled in-house at its MIDC Bhosari, Pune facility.

certifications.title: Certs (RHP)
certifications.body: ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System (applied for; Stage 1 audit completed April 2026, Stage 2 audit scheduled May 2026, certification expected thereafter)

cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Backward integration through in-house design & development (complete design lifecycle - mechanical/electrical system design, control architecture and simulation) using tools such as E-PLAN, SolidWorks, AutoCAD and ZW Cad, and in-house assembly, testing and quality assurance at the MIDC Bhosari, Pune assembly unit (co-located inventory to minimize material movement). Automation-solutions revenue is project-based and integrated end-to-end, while a trading stream procures automation products (PLC, HMI, Servo, AC Drive, digital picking system components) from various suppliers and delivers them in original form. Major raw materials are sourced indigenously, predominantly from Maharashtra (79.45%, 70.98%, 78.82% and 83.83% of total raw material purchases for period ended Oct 31, 2025 and FY2025, FY2024, FY2023). No long-term supply contracts with suppliers. Forward-side lifecycle support includes 12-month warranty, repair/replacement, system upgrades, retrofitting, AMC and on-site installation, commissioning and troubleshooting.

customers.title: Oem (RHP)
customers.body: AIOI Systems Co. Ltd., Japan and AIOI Systems India Private Limited (Feb 2021 tripartite JV; AIOI holds 76%, Adisoft holds 24% in AIOI Systems India Pvt. Ltd.)

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Revenue concentrated in automotive vertical; diversification into non-automotive expected to broaden mix and reduce concentration
- High customer concentration: top 10 customers ~74.09% and top 5 ~63.85% of revenue in FY25
- Geographic concentration in Haryana (56.10% of FY25 sales) and Maharashtra (29.57%)
- Customized project-based execution with lifecycle/AMC and service support revenue

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Strategic capacity expansion through a new factory unit at Pimpri (2799 sq. mtr), IPO-funded (Rs 3,777.34 lakhs), to which the existing assembly unit will be shifted
- Diversification into non-automotive sectors: pharmaceutical manufacturing/packaging, white goods and consumer durables, warehouse automation/intelligent material handling, and water treatment (WTP/STP/RO) and process automation
- Focus on consistent adherence to quality standards, including obtaining ISO 9001:2015 certification
- Build a professional organisation by recruiting and retaining highly-skilled employees
- Geographic expansion beyond current presence in more than 10 states in India

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: The company has commenced establishing a new factory unit at Plot No. B-18 H, Pimpri Industrial Area, MIDC, Pune-411018 measuring 2799 sq. mtr, to which the entire existing assembly unit will be shifted. The build-out (civil construction plus furniture, fixtures & laptops) is to be funded from net IPO proceeds and is intended to enhance business process efficiency, improve order fulfilment timelines, support delivery of non-automotive automation requirements and address rising demand from existing and potential customers.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Well-established in-house design & development capabilities (49 professionals as of Jan 31, 2026; uses E-PLAN, SolidWorks, AutoCAD, ZW Cad)
- Integrated in-house assembling and testing infrastructure under one roof at MIDC Bhosari, Pune
- Enduring relationships with a diversified customer base across more than 10 states in India; ~279 customers served in FY25
- Experienced promoters (28 and 12 years) and skilled employees

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- Customer concentration — Top 10 customers contributed ~74.09% and top 5 ~63.85% of revenue in FY25; loss of a key customer could materially impact revenue
- End-market concentration in automotive — Automotive vertical accounted for ~78.61% of FY25 sales, exposing the company to automotive-sector cyclicality
- Geographic concentration — Haryana (56.10%) and Maharashtra (29.57%) together made up the bulk of FY25 sales
- Execution/expansion risk on new factory — Growth depends on timely establishment and shifting of operations to the new IPO-funded Pimpri factory unit
- Promoter and key-personnel dependence — Business relies heavily on promoters Ajay and Preeti Prabhu and a small design/engineering team
- Working-capital intensity and borrowings — Total borrowings of Rs 1,968.21 lakhs as at Oct 31, 2025; a portion of IPO proceeds and working capital funding is required to support the project-based order book
- Certification not yet obtained — ISO 9001:2015 certification only applied for (Stage 2 audit scheduled May 2026), not yet received

- **Repay and/or pre-pay, in full or part, borrowings availed by the Company using IPO proceeds.**
